newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady, propped by APIs, Amuay.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady, propped by APIs, Amuay.

text.p: NWE gasoline held stable on Wednesday morning despite losses of some 20 cents a barrel on Brent crude.
"The crude is weak but (NYMEX) gasoline is strong. The two reasons are Amuay and bullish API stats," said a refiner.

A big catalytic cracker at Venezuela's Amuay refinery shut due to technical problems but a spokesman said it would be repaired by the end of the week and deliveries will not be affected. API stats showed mogas stocks fell nearly six million barrels in the last week reported. Meanwhile, Eurograde barges traded at $236.00 on Wednesday unchanged from Tuesday and demand for regular was pegged around $230.00.
